pages.title: R01: Dash: Accelerating Distributed Private Convolutional Neural Network Inference with Arithmetic Garbled Circuits
pages.summary: Arithmetic garbling and LabelTensors provide the foundation for offline preparation and local encoded public-weight evaluation. PLLM status: reference primitive only.

pages.title: R02: ReDASH: Fast and efficient Scaling in Arithmetic Garbled Circuits for Secure Outsourced Inference
pages.summary: ReDASH generalizes residue-number-system scaling and uses ScaleQuant+ to reduce encoded-inference overhead. PLLM status: reference primitive only.

pages.title: R03: Garbling Gadgets for Boolean and Arithmetic Circuits
pages.summary: Arithmetic garbling provides free additions and specialized gadgets, with a stated symmetric-primitive security model. PLLM status: PLLM component adaptation.

pages.title: R04: Two Halves Make a Whole: Reducing Data Transfer in Garbled Circuits using Half Gates
pages.summary: Half-gates reduce AND-gate communication while remaining compatible with free XOR. PLLM status: tracked.

pages.title: R05: Garbled Circuit Lookup Tables with Logarithmic Number of Ciphertexts
pages.summary: The lookup construction reduces the number of security-parameter-sized ciphertexts; total communication retains a table-data term. PLLM status: tracked.

pages.title: R06: Duty-Free Bits: Projectivizing Garbling Schemes
pages.summary: This work studies projective conversion from Yao-style bit labels into affine encodings and related vector-OLE applications. PLLM status: tracked.

pages.title: R07: Slalom: Fast, Verifiable and Private Execution of Neural Networks in Trusted Hardware
pages.summary: Slalom outsources masked linear work and uses local verification within a trusted execution partition. PLLM status: tracked.

pages.title: R08: Slalom at the Carnival: Privacy-preserving Inference with Masks from Public Knowledge
pages.summary: Carnival uses subset-sum-based masks to accelerate preprocessing for linear outsourcing. PLLM status: tracked.

pages.title: R09: HyCC: Compilation of Hybrid Protocols for Practical Secure Computation
pages.summary: HyCC compiles high-level programs into hybrid secure-computation protocols. PLLM status: tracked.

pages.title: R10: Oblivious decision program evaluation
pages.summary: Oblivious decision-program protocols evaluate protected decision structures using OT-based reductions. PLLM status: tracked.

pages.title: R11: Factored Edge-Valued Binary Decision Diagrams
pages.summary: Factored edge-valued diagrams share subfunctions through additive and multiplicative edge normalization. PLLM status: tracked.

pages.title: R12: Piranha: A GPU Platform for Secure Computation
pages.summary: Piranha separates device, protocol and application layers for GPU-accelerated secret-sharing computation. PLLM status: tracked.

pages.title: R13: SIGMA: Secure GPT Inference with Function Secret Sharing
pages.summary: SIGMA provides FSS-based secure transformer operations and GPU-backed inference with preprocessing. PLLM status: tracked.

pages.title: R14: FuseFSS: Efficient Secure LLM Inference with Function Secret Sharing
pages.summary: FuseFSS targets fusion and efficiency of secure nonlinear/helper operations in FSS-based LLM inference. PLLM status: tracked.

pages.title: R15: Efficient Pseudorandom Correlation Generators over Z/p^k Z
pages.summary: Galois-ring constructions extend pseudorandom correlation generation to integer rings, including multiplication-related correlations. PLLM status: tracked.

pages.title: R16: Practical Secure Delegated Linear Algebra with Trapdoored Matrices
pages.summary: This work uses trapdoored pseudorandom matrices for efficient delegated linear algebra under an LPN-based approach. PLLM status: tracked.

pages.title: R17: Curl: Private LLMs through Wavelet-Encoded Look-Up Tables
pages.summary: Curl uses wavelet-encoded lookup tables for private nonlinear operations and discusses probabilistic truncation security. PLLM status: tracked.

pages.title: R18: Compact: Approximating Complex Activation Functions for Secure Computation
pages.summary: Compact builds input-density-aware piecewise polynomial approximations for complex activations. PLLM status: tracked.

pages.title: R19: Private and Verifiable Outsourcing of Open-Weight LLM Inference
pages.summary: The abstract describes private and verifiable open-weight inference with two malicious, non-colluding servers and model-owner-published information. PLLM status: tracked.

pages.title: R20: Oblivious Ciphertext Compression via Linear Codes
pages.summary: This work develops oblivious ciphertext compression using linear codes and syndrome decoding. PLLM status: tracked.

pages.title: R21: NEXUS: Secure Transformer Inference Made Non-interactive
pages.summary: NEXUS combines approximate HE with lightweight garbled circuits for non-interactive two-party transformer forward inference. PLLM status: tracked.

pages.title: R22: BumbleBee: Secure Two-party Inference Framework for Large Transformers
pages.summary: BumbleBee implements secure two-party transformer inference with specialized nonlinear protocols and an Apache-2.0 artifact. PLLM status: tracked.

pages.title: R23: MPCache: MPC-Friendly KV Cache Eviction for Efficient Private Large Language Model Inference
pages.summary: MPCache evaluates MPC-friendly static and dynamic KV-cache eviction in a three-party SecretFlow/SPU setting; its artifact focuses state selection and operator costs. PLLM status: PLLM reimplementation.

pages.title: R24: Maverick: Private and Verifiable LLM Inference Made Practical via Matrix-Vector Multiplication Delegation
pages.summary: Maverick delegates matrix-vector multiplication with transparent preprocessing, information-theoretic batch verification, and LPN-based pseudorandom input masking while adding virtually no server-side verification overhead. PLLM status: planned.
